children: AITX announced an initial order for seven RIO™ 360 solar-powered security systems from a major public research university that serves over 25,000 students.
Order placed through RAD channel partner for seven RIO 360 solar-powered security systems for a major public research university.
University serves 25,000+ students and indicated the seven units could be the first of a larger campus deployment.
Seven RIO 360 systems equate to 14 ROSA units, demonstrating RAD's modular platform scaling strategy.
RIO 360 provides 360° autonomous surveillance on a portable solar platform, enabling deployment without permanent power.
Company cautions orders and future expansion are subject to manufacturing, delivery, installation, and customer acceptance risks.
